title.zh: 10 天实战 SGLang
title.en: SGLang in 10 Days

subtitle.zh: 从单机服务到缓存与调度实验
subtitle.en: From a local server to caching and scheduling experiments

description.zh: 10天逐步拆解SGLang：每天有原理图、可运行CPU实验、对照结果、排错和测验。用带原始记录的工程作品连接学习与求职；真实引擎扩展和教学模拟分别说明。
description.en: Ten guided days for SGLang: diagrams, runnable CPU models, controls, troubleshooting and quizzes, culminating in an evidence-backed portfolio. Real-engine extensions are clearly separate from simulations.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；安装、模型下载和真机排障另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours/day, excluding setup, model downloads and hardware troubleshooting

prerequisites.zh: Python、Linux、HTTP；完成推理基础路线，理解 prefill/decode 和 KV cache。
prerequisites.en: Python, Linux and HTTP; complete inference foundations and understand prefill/decode and KV cache.

hardware.zh: CPU教学实验：Python3.9+标准库和普通电脑。真实框架/模型/GPU扩展见实验包README的版本、环境和步骤；当前发布未做GPU实测。
hardware.en: CPU exercises: Python3.9+ standard library and a laptop. See lab README for versions, environments and steps for real-framework/GPU extensions; this publication did not run GPU benchmarks.

zh: 推理工程师
性能工程师
推理 SRE
en: Inference engineer
Performance engineer
Inference SRE

outcome.zh: 一个包含逐日原始JSON、对照CSV、独立函数挑战、文件哈希与个人分析报告的工程作品；清楚区分模拟和真实框架记录。
outcome.en: A portfolio containing daily raw JSON, comparison CSV, an independent function challenge, file hashes and your analysis, separating simulation from actual framework records.

title.zh: 建立引擎地图与版本清单
title.en: Map the engine and pin the environment

lesson.zh: 一个请求依次经过接口适配、tokenizer、调度、执行与响应。SGLang提供其中的推理运行时，模型权重和客户端分别是不同输入与组件。今天的脚本只输出组件地图，尚未启动框架；这样可以先把“哪里坏了”与“哪个参数快”分开。
lesson.en: A request crosses an API adapter, tokenizer, scheduler, executor and response path. SGLang provides the inference runtime; weights and clients are separate components. Today prints a component map without starting the framework, separating failure location from optimization.

task.zh: 给五个组件各写一个输入和输出，指出驱动不兼容与请求字段缺失分别在哪一层发现。
task.en: Write one input/output per component and locate incompatible drivers versus missing request fields.

evidence.zh: day01.json的基线与changed两份记录；本人修改的代码差异和对照解释。
evidence.en: Baseline and changed day01.json records, your code diff and an explanation of the comparison.

body.zh: 基线输出五个组件和版本0.5.23。changed情境变成错误模型名：请求应在实际模型执行前被拒绝。不要把返回HTTP错误当成模型推理变慢；也不要把图上的五个框当成五台独立机器。

question.zh: 错误模型名应怎样处理？
question.en: How should an invalid model name be handled?

options.zh: 在执行前校验并返回错误

explanation.zh: 明确拒绝保留接口语义，避免客户端误以为获得目标模型结果。
explanation.en: Explicit rejection preserves API semantics and prevents substitution being mistaken for the requested model.

title.zh: 校验请求协议，再选做真实服务
title.en: Validate requests before optional real serving

lesson.zh: 本地协议模型验证JSON对象、模型名和messages中的字符串内容。它只演示请求校验，不生成文本。真实服务的状态码还受具体API与版本影响，所以先固定自己的合约，再将真实响应逐项对照。
lesson.en: The offline protocol model validates an object, model name and string message content. It does not generate text. Real status codes depend on endpoint/version; establish a contract and then compare actual responses.

task.zh: 自行加入空messages、数字content和正确请求，先预测状态再运行validate_request。真实GPU路线见README，服务与客户端各开一个终端。

question.zh: 错误模型名在这个模型中返回？
question.en: Which status represents an unknown model here?

explanation.zh: 404是本练习定义的未知模型合约；不代表所有接口都采用同一错误码。
explanation.en: 404 is this exercise’s unknown-model contract, not a universal API rule.

question.zh: 为什么要保留失败请求？
question.en: Why retain failed requests?

options.zh: 它们影响成功率和可用性
options.en: They affect success rate and availability

explanation.zh: 只统计成功请求的延迟可以，但成功率分母要包含所有提交请求。
explanation.en: Successful-only latency is useful, but success-rate denominators include all submitted requests.

title.zh: 设计能比较的负载与指标
title.en: Build a comparable workload

lesson.zh: 短问答与长上下文共享一个总体平均值，会隐藏哪一类受影响。本练习保留类别与样本量，用nearest-rank分位数：排序后取ceil(p×N)位置。小样本的p95常等于最大值，不能据此承诺生产SLO。
lesson.en: An overall average hides which workload class suffers. Keep classes and counts; nearest-rank percentiles select ceil(p×N) after sorting. With few samples p95 often equals the maximum, insufficient for production SLO claims.

task.zh: 将长请求复制10次，检查平均值、p95和每类数量；解释总体指标变化但短请求未变的原因。
task.en: Duplicate long requests ten times; inspect mean, p95 and counts, and explain why aggregate metrics change while short requests do not.

title.zh: 手算与反例
title.en: Worked example and counterexample

body.zh: 基线短请求[10,12,14,16]的p95=16，长请求[70,90]的p95=90。changed只给长请求增加110和130，总体p95升到130，短请求仍16；这说明总体变差可能来自流量构成。
body.en: Short requests [10,12,14,16] have p95=16; long [70,90] have p95=90. Adding 110 and 130 only to the long class raises overall p95 to 130 while short p95 stays 16: the mix can explain deterioration.

body.zh: 拖动排队时间，保持prefill/decode不变，观察TTFT增加而decode本身不变。交互图描述一个请求的分解；本日JSON的P95来自一组请求，两种视角不能混写成同一个统计量。
body.en: Increase queue time while holding prefill/decode fixed: TTFT rises without changing decode work. The widget decomposes one request; the daily JSON summarizes a population with P95. They are different statistics.

title.zh: 理解 token 前缀与缓存淘汰
title.en: Understand token prefixes and eviction

lesson.zh: Radix缓存利用token序列的公共前缀；字符相似不等于token相同。本练习先比较人工token ID，再用整项LRU理解容量压力。LRU字典并不是SGLang实际radix树，也没有实现被活动请求锁定的块。
lesson.en: Radix caching reuses common token prefixes; similar text need not tokenize identically. Compare synthetic token IDs, then use whole-entry LRU to study pressure. This dictionary is not SGLang’s radix tree and does not model pinned active blocks.

task.zh: 完成student.py的prefix_length；再尝试空数组、完全相同、只共享首项三种边界。
task.en: Implement prefix_length in student.py; test empty, identical and one-token shared-prefix arrays.

title.zh: 前缀匹配与淘汰是两件事
title.en: Prefix matching and eviction are distinct

body.zh: Radix缓存利用token序列的公共前缀；字符相似不等于token相同。本练习先比较人工token ID，再用整项LRU理解容量压力。LRU字典并不是SGLang实际radix树，也没有实现被活动请求锁定的块。
body.en: Radix caching reuses common token prefixes; similar text need not tokenize identically. Compare synthetic token IDs, then use whole-entry LRU to study pressure. This dictionary is not SGLang’s radix tree and does not model pinned active blocks.

title.zh: 手算与反例
title.en: Worked example and counterexample

body.zh: A,B,A,C,B在容量2时仅第三次A命中，之后B已淘汰；容量3时最后B也命中。两token序列[10,20,30,40]与[10,20,31]只共享前两个ID。命中意味着可复用状态，不直接意味着decode加速。
body.en: A,B,A,C,B with capacity2 hits only the repeated A; B is later evicted. Capacity3 also retains B. The two supplied token arrays share exactly two IDs. A hit enables reuse but does not directly accelerate decoding.

title.zh: 动手调参：连接图解与实验
title.en: Change parameters: connect widget and lab

body.zh: 在交互图中修改共享前缀比例，再解释为什么整项LRU的命中次数不直接等于token命中比例。实验中的A/B/C是整项缓存键；真正的前缀树可共享部分路径，这正是简化模型的边界。
body.en: Change the shared-prefix fraction and explain why whole-entry LRU hits do not equal token hit ratio. A/B/C are whole-entry keys; a radix tree can share partial paths, which marks the limit of this model.

body.zh: GPU层命中后不访问CPU；CPU层命中率应在GPU未命中的请求中计算。顺序访问模型先付1ms GPU查找，未命中再付10ms CPU查找，仍未命中再付100ms重算。实际HiCache可能重叠传输，本模型没有。
body.en: CPU lookup occurs only after a GPU miss, so CPU hit probability is conditional on that miss. The sequential model pays1ms GPU lookup, then10ms CPU lookup on miss, then100ms recomputation on both misses. It excludes HiCache transfer overlap.

title.zh: 手算与反例

body.zh: GPU命中0.5、CPU条件命中0.8时，期望=1+0.5×(10+0.2×100)=16ms；CPU条件命中降到0.2，期望46ms。两层命中率不可直接相加。
body.en: With GPU hit0.5 and conditional CPU hit0.8, expectation is1+0.5×(10+0.2×100)=16ms. Reducing CPU hit to0.2 gives46ms. The two hit probabilities cannot simply be added.

body.zh: 把本地命中设为50%、远端条件命中设为80%、远端访问10ms，重算固定100ms，可复现16ms均值。把远端条件命中降到20%，得到46ms；两个百分比的分母不同，不要相加。
body.en: Set local hits to50%, conditional remote hits to80% and remote latency to10ms; fixed recomputation100ms yields16ms. Reducing conditional remote hits to20% yields46ms. The probabilities have different denominators.

body.zh: 基线四条状态有两成功、一超时、一错误，成功率0.5，成功延迟p95=30。changed只保留超时和错误，成功率0且p95=null。保留失败后才能比较恢复动作是否改善可用性。
body.en: Two successes, one timeout and one error give success rate0.5 and successful p95=30. The changed all-failed run has success rate0 and p95=null. Retaining failures permits a meaningful recovery comparison.

title.zh: 错误与恢复也进入实验报告 · 流程
title.en: Include failures and recovery in the report · flow

caption.zh: 逻辑示意；数字来自明确的教学假设，不是框架性能实测。
caption.en: Logical illustration: numbers follow stated teaching assumptions, not measured framework performance.

title.zh: 运行基线并保留原始文件
title.en: Run the baseline and keep raw files

body.zh: 进入解压后的sglang目录，先阅读lab.py中day9函数，预测结果再运行。
body.en: Inside the extracted sglang directory, read day9 in lab.py and predict results before running.

title.zh: 只改变一个条件，再解释差异
title.en: Change one condition and explain the difference

body.zh: 为模型名错误、超时分别写检查顺序和停止条件；不要把所有失败设为无限重试。 用--variant changed运行提供的对照，再在副本中做自己的修改。
body.en: Write checks and stopping conditions for unknown-model errors and timeouts; avoid infinite retries for every failure. Run the supplied --variant changed control, then make your own change in a copy.

fix.zh: 把无样本显示为缺失，不转换成0；旁边保留失败数。
fix.en: Plot it as missing, not zero, and retain failure counts.

fix.zh: 先分类失败，限制重试次数与并发，并观察队列。
fix.en: Classify failures first, bound retries/concurrency and inspect queues.

question.zh: 全部失败时成功延迟p95应为？
question.en: What is successful p95 when all requests fail?

explanation.zh: 没有成功样本，分位数未定义。
explanation.en: There are no successful samples, so the percentile is undefined.

question.zh: 恢复后应该保留什么？
question.en: What should a recovery record retain?

explanation.zh: 可复查的因果链需要恢复前后证据。
explanation.en: An inspectable causal chain needs evidence before and after recovery.

title.zh: 交付一个可被复现的推理作品
title.en: Deliver a reproducible serving project

lesson.zh: 结课作品围绕一个可证伪的问题：选择前九天的一项假设，保持输入和其余参数一致，比较基线与改动。自动生成的报告只整理证据，不替你解释结果。需要完成自己的函数挑战，并说明示例代码与个人贡献。
lesson.en: Build a falsifiable project around one assumption from the previous days. Hold inputs and other parameters fixed while comparing baseline and change. Generated reports organize evidence, not explanations. Complete your own function challenge and distinguish supplied code from personal contributions.

task.zh: 复现两组报告，完成student.py并通过check.py，再把一个真实反例与本人改动写入报告。
task.en: Reproduce both reports, implement student.py and pass check.py, then document a counterexample and your contribution.

evidence.zh: 两份实验目录、通过学生检查的实现、无TODO的报告和复现说明。
evidence.en: Two experiment directories, your passing implementation, a completed report and reproduction instructions.

zh: 从空目录能按照说明完成实验或明确的替代任务。
区分实测、模拟、推断和待验证结论。
结论说明优化适用条件以及至少一个失败案例。
en: Instructions support reproduction from a clean directory or a clearly defined alternative task.
Separate measured, simulated, inferred and unverified claims.
State applicability conditions and at least one failed experiment.

noGpu.zh: CPU路径可完成全部模型与作品；必须标明simulated。真实SDK/GPU实验不是本机已验证部分。
noGpu.en: The CPU path completes all models and the portfolio; label it simulated. SDK/GPU execution was not validated here.

title.zh: 可复现链条
title.en: Reproduction chain

body.zh: day10会重新运行九个教学实验，保存逐日JSON、汇总CSV和文件哈希。分别使用两个输出目录，避免把前后结果覆盖。重复确定性模拟只验证重放一致，不能建立硬件加速的统计置信度。
body.en: day10 reruns nine experiments, saving daily JSON, summary CSV and hashes. Use separate output directories. Repeating deterministic models checks replay consistency; it does not establish statistical confidence in hardware speedups.

title.zh: 用自己的解释完成作品
title.en: Finish with your own explanation

body.zh: 填写REPORT.md的所有TODO，写明问题、本人改动、输入、对照、一个不改善的条件和下一次实验。check.py默认检查student.py；--reference只验证随包参考实现，不能据此声称自己的挑战已完成。
body.en: Fill every REPORT.md TODO: question, own change, inputs, controls, a no-benefit condition and the next experiment. check.py checks student.py by default; --reference checks the supplied solution and does not demonstrate your implementation.

title.zh: 独立函数的输入输出
title.en: Independent function contracts

body.zh: 独立实现完整块对齐的公共前缀长度与仅成功请求的nearest-rank P95。例：[1,2,3]与[1,2,4]、块长2得到2；1至20共20个成功延迟的P95为19。加入超时99999后成功P95不变，但报告的成功率必须降低。块长0或成功延迟NaN应拒绝。
body.en: Implement block-aligned common-prefix length and nearest-rank P95 for successful requests. Prefixes[1,2,3]/[1,2,4] with block2 return2; successful latencies1..20 give P95=19. Adding a99999ms timeout must not change successful P95, but lowers success rate. Reject zero block size and NaN success latency.

title.zh: 从实验到作品
title.en: From experiments to portfolio

caption.zh: 作品可以是清楚标注的模拟分析；没有真机实验就不写真实引擎性能结论。
caption.en: A portfolio may contain clearly labeled simulation analysis; do not claim real-engine performance without measurements.

title.zh: 在两个目录复现全部实验
title.en: Reproduce all experiments in separate directories

body.zh: 以下脚本只运行CPU教学模型，不连接真实服务；检查每份文件的evidence字段。
body.en: These scripts run CPU models only and connect to no real service. Inspect evidence labels.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py day10 --out out/final-base
python3 lab.py day10 --variant changed --out out/final-changed

expected.en: Each directory contains nine daily JSON files, results.csv, manifest.json and REPORT.md.

title.zh: 完成独立挑战与报告
title.en: Complete your challenge and report

body.zh: 编辑student.py中的TODO，再运行检查。第一次未完成时显示NOT YET是预期结果；可以看提示，最后再核对参考解。
body.en: Edit student.py TODOs before checking. An initial NOT YET is expected. Use the hints and compare the reference only after attempting your own solution.

expected.zh: 完成后student检查显示PASS；报告的TODO由你填写，selfcheck通过不代表报告已完成。
expected.en: Your completed student check shows PASS. Fill report TODOs yourself; selfcheck does not complete the report.

fix.zh: 先实现student.py，不要把--reference通过误当自己的通过；参考边界案例定位。
fix.en: Implement student.py; passing --reference is not passing your own work. Use the boundary cases to debug.

symptom.zh: 报告只有数字没有解释

fix.zh: 补充假设、改动、反例与未验证项；请同伴从命令重算一项结论。
fix.en: Add assumptions, changes, counterexamples and unverified claims; ask a peer to recompute one conclusion.

question.zh: 确定性模拟重复三次能证明GPU加速吗？
question.en: Do three deterministic replays prove GPU acceleration?

explanation.zh: 硬件结论需要真实运行、环境、负载与波动记录。
explanation.en: Hardware conclusions require measurements, environment, workload and variation.

question.zh: 以下哪项最能体现个人贡献？
question.en: Which best expresses personal contribution?

options.zh: 展示自己的修改、证据和局限
options.en: Showing your changes, evidence and limitations

explanation.zh: 可解释的改动和证据让别人能审阅你的判断。
explanation.en: Explainable changes and evidence let others review your judgement.

title.zh: 10 天实战 SGLang · 实验包
title.en: SGLang in 10 Days · lab kit

description.zh: Python3.9+标准库，普通电脑可完成全部CPU教学实验；含独立挑战、参考检查和报告导出。真实框架路线见README，需另备兼容环境。
description.en: Python3.9+ standard library: laptop-ready teaching experiments, independent challenges, reference checks and report export. Real-framework routes in README require compatible environments.
